_comment: Routes for Waterbike AI. Bearings and leg distances are computed from
location coordinates; leg distance is scaled so the route total matches
the operator catalog figure, which reflects real on-water path length.
min_tier is the operator-assigned floor. Conditions can raise the required
tier or close a route, never lower it below min_tier.
current_scale is modeled from distance to the Golden Gate, not measured.
night_difficulty is not_permitted throughout pending Canon section 17.
